$comment: Wave V4 of docs/COMPONENT-VARIANTS-PLAN.md (banking widgets): what variants.json has no field for. The variants themselves, their packs and the motion effect names are in variants.json; here, per component, how each motion looks and its reduced-motion form, and its empty and loading states (loadingProperty: the widget takes loading in every pack).

leftToOtherWaves.number: V5 (rolling-digits, count-up and scrub-field are effects)

motion.enter: Fades in
motion.hover: None: an avatar is not a control
motion.press: None
motion.change: A new photo cross-fades over the initials
motion.reduced: Changes at once

states.empty: No photo: the initials of the name; no name: an empty circle with no label
states.loading: None: the initials show until the photo loads

motion.enter: Rows settle in from 8 px below, 30 ms apart (--bx-dur-base, --bx-ease-standard)
motion.hover: The row takes the surface tint; the action underlines
motion.press: The row or its action scales to 0.98 and back
motion.change: A new row fades in at its place; a removed row fades out and the rest close up
motion.reduced: No movement: rows appear at once and only colours change

states.empty: "Nothing here yet." (the emptyText line, said by screen readers)
states.loading: Three skeleton rows under the heading; role status "Loading" with aria-busy, set by the loading property

motion.enter: The card fades and rises 8 px (--bx-dur-base)
motion.hover: None on the card; the Show or Hide button takes the surface tint
motion.press: The Show or Hide button scales to 0.97
motion.change: Hiding or showing cross-fades the amount; a new amount rolls its digits (the number effects of wave V5)
motion.reduced: The amount changes at once with no fade or roll

states.empty: No amount: the amount line is left empty and the label stays
states.loading: A skeleton line in place of the amount; role status "Loading" with aria-busy, set by the loading property
